TextView.android:text: Fast, transparent, and paperless public service for Barangay Onse citizens. Request clearances online, track documents in real time, and stay connected with your council.
Official clearance certifying residency and good moral standing for employment, legal needs, or bank requirements.
Issued free of charge for medical, hospital, educational scholarship, DSWD, or financial assistance.
Waives government pre-employment document fees (NBI, Police Clearance, PSA) under Republic Act No. 11261.
4 Simple Steps to Claim Your Clearance

01 • Fill Application Online
Select your certificate, enter your resident details, and choose copy count.

02 • Desk Officer Verification
Barangay records officers verify your Barangay Onse residency & precinct.

03 • Official Signing & QR Code
Signed by Punong Barangay Roberto B. Alba with a unique tracking code.

04 • Express Pickup at Window 2
Present 1 valid ID at Barangay Onse Hall for fast release.
